def card_block():
    a = T(x)
    z = (a.layernorm(eps=1e-6).realize() @ T(wq).T).realize().reshape(1,65,3,1,64)
    q,k,v = [z[:,:,i].transpose(1,2).contiguous().realize() for i in range(3)]
    s = ((q @ k.transpose(-1,-2))*0.125).realize()
    p = s.softmax(-1).realize()
    h = (p @ v).realize().transpose(1,2).contiguous().realize().reshape(1,65,64)
    a = (a + h @ T(wo).T).realize()
    h = (a.layernorm(eps=1e-6).realize() @ T(w1).T).gelu().realize()
    return (a + h @ T(w2).T).realize()

def reference():
    a = x.astype(np.float32)
    def norm(z):
        d = z - z.mean(-1, keepdims=True)
        return d / np.sqrt((d*d).mean(-1, keepdims=True) + np.float32(1e-6))
    z = (norm(a) @ wq.astype(np.float32).T).reshape(1,65,3,1,64)
    q,k,v = [z[:,:,i].swapaxes(1,2) for i in range(3)]
    s = (q @ k.swapaxes(-1,-2))*np.float32(0.125)
    e = np.exp(s - s.max(-1, keepdims=True))
    h = ((e / e.sum(-1,keepdims=True)) @ v).swapaxes(1,2).reshape(1,65,64)
    a = a + h @ wo.astype(np.float32).T
    h = norm(a) @ w1.astype(np.float32).T
    h = np.float32(0.5)*h*(1 + np.tanh(np.float32(np.sqrt(2/np.pi))*(h + np.float32(0.044715)*h*h*h)))
    return a + h @ w2.astype(np.float32).T
